name: Yatsugaike ~Yatsugaike Kitan~
source:
Main character is born in a military officer family. He's a shy boy and currently lives alone due to family circumstances. One day he witnesses sexual assault in the park, tries to help and gets murdered as a result. He awakens as a spirit. He can't affect the world except for when in situation that caused his death. He can materialize only when insulting girls in the park...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角出生于军官家庭。他是一个害羞的男孩，由于家庭原因目前独自生活。有一天，他在公园目睹了性侵犯，试图提供帮助，结果却被谋杀了。他作为一个灵魂苏醒了。除非处于导致他死亡的情况，否则他无法影响世界。只有在公园里侮辱女孩的时候他才会现身……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
